# M18-S9: the toolchain ships no arena package and no arenas experiment.
# GOEXPERIMENT=arenas is rejected the way any unknown experiment is, so no
# build can enable it, and the std list below would include an arena package
# if one shipped.

env GOEXPERIMENT=arenas
! go env GOEXPERIMENT
stderr 'unknown GOEXPERIMENT arenas'
! go list std
stderr 'unknown GOEXPERIMENT arenas'

env GOEXPERIMENT=
go list std
! stdout arena
! go list logos/arena
